answer: Sybil resistance rests on costly, non-transferable work. Every identity posts a bond locked behind a graduated cooldown, so assembling a raven flock of fresh keys means fronting capital that stays illiquid for a hundred epochs. Weight also decays unless reciprocity holds: credit flows only between parties that survived prior audits. A basalt-hard record of past verdict accuracy sets the reputation prior, so newborns start near zero, and the saffron tier of rare attestations needs peers to co-sign your history. Cost: capital at risk plus months per fake identity, with no resale value.
